- Game Hub: a native shelf drawn by Rust and wgpu (a row of thin boxes with the console case, a swipe that rolls them, a flip to the back, a moving background); turn it on in Game Hub settings (Native shelf, preview). The web shelf stays the default.
- Game Hub: the built-in and web games' boxes are drawn when asked and kept only in memory: about 70 MB less on the phone. Hidden apps are no longer dropped from the lists, the Hidden list also shows apps hidden outside Pulse, Select games lists phone games, hidden games, then other apps. Termux is never hidden.
- Keyboard: the language model also exists in Rust (about four times faster, with the Java code as the fallback); next-word suggestions follow the whole sentence; learned words are saved once after a burst of typing (typing after a long message was slow).
- Series and movies: a stream the add-on gives only as a torrent downloads with the torrent engine in Pulse (full build, 64-bit); an optional local torrent server (Stremio's or another app's) can be set instead; without the switch, magnet links stay off.
- Files: the plain list shows names only (sizes and dates belong to the Detailed list); a button brings back the columns on a wide screen, the columns view has filter and sort and slides its columns in; files saved with Save to show in Recent; apps hidden outside Pulse show in the App manager.
- YTXTube: pulling the video down follows the finger and settles on release; brightness and volume swipes work on the sides and keep going; the screen stays on while a video plays; the Library has no Series and movies card.
- Pulse keeps its folders under Download/Pulse (desktop, recycle bin, ArtCraft, downloaded books); none at the storage root.
- Weather: fine, short and dense rain; the jungle waterfall is drawn again; shorter vines.
- Widgets: a Photo frame (a square tile with your own photo) and a Contacts widget; Notes shows on the Widgets page; the launcher calls them gadgets.
- Auto clicker: a small half-transparent dot as the target; the floating bar drags from its buttons. PDF search scrolls to the found word. Pulse's extra apps have a lighter blue icon background.
- A crash in the Toolkit and the music Recap (a scrolling page measured with infinite height) is guarded.
- Weather: real rain in three depths (many far fine drops, a middle layer, a few near long bright ones) leaning with the wind, rings where drops land on the ground and a light mist; the scenery and the sky both use it.
- Keyboard: a copied file (music, video, an APK, a document) waits in the bar's right slot to be pasted into a chat, from a copy in the cache (nothing is saved elsewhere). Game Hub: the native GPU shelf is on by default where it is available (Game Hub settings turns it off).
- Keyboard menu: the first row is Gamepad, Emoji, AI fix and Key layout; the password manager (Quick auth) is a tile of the menu instead of an icon in the top bar.
- Game Hub native shelf: boxes slide in one after another, the middle one floats and leans with the swipe, a launch animation takes the box towards you before the game starts; a header (title, count, clock, position), search, details, flip and menu buttons. It is the default where it is available.
- Keyboard: a screenshot or picture that lands on the clipboard takes the bar's right slot from an older copied text. Screen cover Neofetch: the card is sized to its real width, so the lines are no longer cut at the right. Opening animation has a length setting (short, normal, long); the start screen of Android stays until Pulse has drawn its first frame.
- YTXTube has an opening animation (the red play button pops in with a soft ring and fades, under a second); the Game Hub native shelf's intro and launch animations are shorter.
- Game Hub launch screen: the box picture is shown whole with rounded corners (its top band and bottom were cut).
- Game Hub: Select games works in the native settings (the phone's games, hidden games, other apps; a tick keeps a game on the shelf). Closing another Pulse app no longer stops a YTXTube video in the picture-in-picture window.
